data.name: Sharvuksha
data.long_meaning: A name for a girl derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sharvu' meaning Goddess Sharvani, 'Ishwara' meaning God, and 'Ksha' meaning energy. This name signifies the power and strength of the goddess, as well as her role in the creation and sustenance of the universe.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is believed to invoke the blessings of the goddess Sharvani, who is the embodiment of strength, nourishment, and prosperity. It is also a reminder of the divine energy that sustains all of creation.
data.numerology_meaning: The number 6 represents harmony, love, and balance in numerology. It is associated with the nurturing and caring energy of the mother, and is a sign of selflessness and dedication to others.

It represents the power of Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, dreams, music, art, wisdom, and learning. With the name Sharvuksha, an individual is constantly reminded to stay connected to their spiritual self, seek wisdom, and channel their energy towards positive growth and transformation.
